_comment: The Apps Script source manifest — the single list of files that make up the
deployed script. Every consumer reads this instead of hardcoding a filename:
the four test suites, scripts/patch_version.js, scripts/validate.py,
scripts/prod_health.py, the .claspignore hygiene check, and the deploy
workflow's syntax lint, push order and deployed-file assertion.
Read it via scripts/sources.js (Node) or scripts/sources.py (Python) rather
than parsing it again by hand — a third parser is a third thing to drift.
sources    — concatenation AND clasp push order. Apps Script has no module
system: every .gs file is concatenated into ONE global scope, so
these are not modules and nothing here imports anything. The
order is the pre-split file order, and concatenating these files
with no separator reproduces the pre-split SpamDetector.gs byte
for byte — that is the proof the split moved code and changed
none, and it is why concatSource() joins with ''. Do not reorder
without re-establishing that property.
versionFile — the one file carrying both version markers ('* @version X.Y.Z'
and 'const SCRIPT_VERSION'). Config.gs, because the file header
that carries @version sits directly above SCRIPT_VERSION and the
two must stay together: patch_version.js rewrites one file, and
validate.py fails if either marker appears more than once across
the whole manifest.
